title: CLAM mitochondrial genome pipeline
description: Schema for launching the CLAM mitochondrial genome pipeline from Seqera.

input.description: Input FASTQ glob or BAM path/glob. FASTQ accepts one R1/R2 pair or lane FASTQs (for example *_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz and *_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz); matching lanes are concatenated per mate. BAM example: /path/to/data/*.bam

input_type.description: Type of input files supplied to the pipeline.

analysis_mode.description: Choose whether to run with or without the nuclear-remapping and MitoScape NUMT-correction branch.

outdir.description: The output directory where pipeline results will be saved.

clam_container.description: Container image used for CLAM core processes.

mutect2_container.description: Container image used for the Mutect2 process.

mitoscape_container.description: Container image used for the MitoScape process.

annotation_container.description: Container image used for annotation summary processes.

annotation_high_depth.description: Coverage depth threshold for high-confidence heteroplasmy summaries.

annotation_medium_depth.description: Coverage depth threshold for medium-confidence heteroplasmy summaries.

annotation_high_alt_reads.description: Alternative-read threshold for high-confidence heteroplasmy summaries.

annotation_medium_alt_reads.description: Alternative-read threshold for medium-confidence heteroplasmy summaries.

annotation_max_af_discordance.description: Maximum caller allele-fraction difference allowed for high-confidence consensus calls.

maf_center.description: Center value written to lightweight CLAM MAF files.

maf_ncbi_build.description: NCBI_Build value written to lightweight CLAM MAF files.

mitomap_variant_table.description: Optional local MITOMAP-derived variant table used to annotate CLAM TSV outputs. When unset, MITOMAP annotation is skipped.

mitomap_keep_columns.description: Maximum number of non-coordinate columns copied from the MITOMAP table into annotated TSVs.

run_numt_exploration.description: Optional WGS-only exploratory analysis of MitoScape-rejected reads. Outputs are NUMT-like read summaries, not confirmed NUMT insertion calls.

numt_exploration_min_mapq.description: Minimum nuclear remapping MAPQ used to count high-confidence NUMT-like alignments in the exploratory NUMT report.

numt_exploration_cluster_window.description: Window size in bp used to summarize nuclear loci for MitoScape-rejected reads.

report_mt_length.description: Mitochondrial reference length used to compute coverage breadth in the HTML report.

classifier.description: Path to the MitoScape classifier jar inside the MitoScape container.

mitomap.description: Path to the MitoScape mitomap linkage disequilibrium resource.

model.description: Path to the MitoScape classifier model.

annotation.description: Path to the mutserve rCRS annotation file.
